title: Biodiversity and megadiverse India
quote: Rosen coined, Wilson popularised; tropics richest on land, coral reefs richest in the sea

Meaning
rows: Variation within a species (rice varieties of **Oryza sativa**)
Variety of ecosystems; one cannot replace another

boxes.title: Patterns & values
items: Richest on land: ==**tropical rainforests**==; sea: **coral reefs**
Falls from **tropics → poles** and low → high altitude; ants **10** vs **2,000**
Tropics: undisturbed evolutionary time, stable climate, more solar energy
**log S = log C + Z log A**; Z **0.1-0.2**, continents **0.6-1.2**
**Consumptive** = used, not sold; **Productive** = sold commercially
**Option** value: unknown future uses (new drugs, crop genes)

boxes.title: India's share & ranks
items: **2.4%** land, **7-8%** recorded species, about **18%** people
**10th** plant-rich; **11th** endemic higher vertebrates; **6th** crop origin
**4 of the 36** hotspots; ==one of **17** megadiverse countries==
Megadiverse criteria: **5,000 endemic plants** + border marine ecosystems
2025: **709** animal species = **483** new + **226** records; fauna **1,05,953**
Top state 2025: **Kerala 98**; top group **Hymenoptera**
